newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Congress asks United Front for talks - UNI.
newsitem.headline: India's Congress asks United Front for talks - UNI.

text.p: India's ruling United Front coalition on Thursday was considering a request from the Congress party for a fresh round of talks to resolve a political impasse, United News of India (UNI) said.
The news agency said United Front leaders had postponed a news conference, originally set for 5 p.m. (1130 GMT), following the Congress request.
Earlier on Thursday, a second round of talks between the two political formations ended in a deadlock when both sides stuck to their bargaining positions.
